text:
elaine: Pushing a set of hero/subhead variants + a quick webinar gating + inbound routing proposal. Need rapid feedback — goal: lock copy for the launch post + webinar landing by EOD PT. Posting snippets below.

matt: Cool — please include explicit CTA routing. For Dedicated leads do we route straight to AE or triage first?

elaine: Short plan: Hosted -> self-serve signup flow; Dedicated -> AE queue (priority); Private -> Solutions engineer request. Draft copy + routing: 
```
Hero A: "Ship LLM features reliably. Choose Hosted, Dedicated, or Private."
Subhead A: "Same API. Predictable latency, lower cost, and enterprise controls when you need them."
Primary CTA A: "Get started" -> Hosted signup (self-serve)
Secondary CTA A: "Contact sales" -> Dedicated lead form (AE routing)
Tertiary CTA A: "Request private deployment" -> Private intake (SE follow-up)

Hero B: "Production LLM inference that adapts to your needs."
Subhead B: "From quick hosted experiments to private, air-gapped deployments—one platform."
Primary CTA B: "Explore plans" -> generic landing (segmentation)

---
Routing quick map (for web team):
- form.field: "preferred_tier" values: hosted / dedicated / private
- hosted -> marketing.signup.selfserve
- dedicated -> sales.queue.AE_high_priority
- private -> se.queue.solution_intake
```

sasha: Love the clarity. Small note: for the public-facing benchmark blurbs, keep them non-operatory. Suggest: "Benchmark: median response latency under 120ms for common text workloads (popular model variants)." That reads better than p99 numbers in hero.

marco: For the webinar gating, we should capture a quick "primary use-case" field so we can route leads: infra / compliance / product / research. Mapping: infra -> infra-ops AE, compliance -> enterprise-compliance SE, product/research -> nurture. I'll paste the simple mapping we use for SFDC.

joel: Copy nit for Private: emphasize KMS/HSM + VPC options. Maybe tweak subhead B (private part) to: "Bring Redwood into your VPC or on-prem with KMS/HSM controls and audit logs."

elaine: Updated hero B subhead per @joel and @sasha bench wording. New combined snippet for landing top-of-page: 
```
Hero final: "Production LLM inference that adapts to your needs."
Subhead final: "From fast hosted APIs to dedicated capacity and private deployments—same API, enterprise controls, and measurable latency. Benchmark: median response latency under 120ms for common text workloads."
Primary CTA: "Get started" -> hosted_signup
Secondary CTA: "Contact sales" -> dedicated_form
Tertiary CTA: "Request private trial" -> private_intake
```

matt: I'll wire the form fields to SFDC tonight. Mapping snippet for infra team to implement (will add to web ticket):
```
form fields -> SFDC mapping:
- email -> Lead.Email
- company -> Lead.Company
- preferred_tier -> Lead.Preferred_Tier__c
- primary_use_case -> Lead.Use_Case__c
- webinar_opt_in -> Lead.Webinar_Opt_In__c
- route -> if Preferred_Tier__c == 'dedicated' then Owner = AE_Pool_Dedicated else if 'private' assign SE_Intake
```

sasha: Also: create a two-week nurture for Dedicated leads with one technical case study + latency/cost benchmark. Put "webinar recording" as touch 2. I'll coordinate the sequence with growth.

deploy-bot: [deploy-preview] Landing copy v3 uploaded to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/landing-preview (expires in 48h) :white_check_mark:

elaine: Thanks — locking these elements unless I hear major objections by 5pm PT. If anyone wants to A/B test hero A vs final, flag here and I'll queue it. :rocket:
